text:
sara-sales: Heads up — Acme demo is blocked, getting 401s hitting /v1/generate. They tried the quickstart.

devin-se: can you paste the curl + response body?

sara-sales: curl below, response: 401 {"error":"unauthorized","reason":"key_unbound"}

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer key_abc123" \
  -H "x-org-id: org-acmecorp" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-3","input":"hello"}'
```

ops-bot: auth.log: 2026-06-12T18:05:10Z ERROR token=key_abc123 validation failed: key bound to org=org-acme-old, project=acme-main; request org=org-acmecorp, project=demo-1

ingrid-ml: Looks like the key's org binding doesn't match the request org header. Confirm which org the POC key was created under.

devin-se: also check scopes — if the key lacks inference:generate you'll get a 403-type flow. But logs show unbound->401.

ethan-eng: quick CLI check: rwctl keys inspect key_abc123

```text
id: key_abc123
org: org-acme-old
projects: [acme-main]
scopes: [inference:generate]
created_by: jira/SALES-456
```

devin-se: so root cause: sales-provisioned key was created in the wrong org (acme-old). Two remediations:
- generate a new key under org-acmecorp via Console -> API Keys (fastest)
- OR rebind existing key (requires org admin). Rebinding needs Corp IAM approval.

amy-cs: If we create a new key, does that affect pricing or require new ent. paperwork? Acme is asking.

ingrid-ml: no pricing change for a key swap. If they want per-project isolation we can advise dedicated keys + billing mapping (sales can discuss).

sara-sales: can you issue the new key now? => customer waiting on demo today.

devin-se: I can create a scoped demo key tied to org-acmecorp, project=demo-1 with inference scope. Will push in ~10m and paste.

(10m)
devin-se: new key created: key_demo_acme_789 — tested with same curl, 200 OK, streaming started.

sara-sales: nailed it, sharing with Acme. Thanks team! :tada:

amy-cs: note for the record — added to POC sheet that key was wrong-org; follow up: sales to confirm who in Acme should be org admin.

ethan-eng: optional: add a validation error to quickstart that checks header x-org-id vs key binding and prints a clearer hint.

devin-se: +1 we'll add a better error message (internal ticket) so future demos fail softer.

sara-sales: closing here. will reopen if anything else pops up.
